description: Convert any website or URL to clean Markdown optimised for LLM ingestion, RAG pipelines and AI document processing — no setup needed

apify_api_key.description: Your Apify API token (optional). When provided the actor runs live and returns real data. Get one free at https://apify.com/sign-up

chunk_for_rag.description: Emit overlap-aware Markdown chunks (one dataset record per chunk) instead of one record per page — ready to embed into a vector database

chunk_overlap_tokens.description: Token overlap carried between consecutive chunks so retrieval keeps context across edges

chunk_size_tokens.description: Approximate target size of each RAG chunk, in tokens

max_pages.description: Maximum number of pages to convert

start_urls.description: The web pages to convert (one per line)

name: website_to_markdown
title: Website to Markdown Crawler — LLM & RAG, Firecrawl Alt
